decision.implementation_need: No entry in authorized_deterministic_operations_current_epoch matches this composite multi-feature fusion operation, and none of the existing per-family screen scripts (research_v3/*_screen.py) implement cross-family feature fusion or a frozen composite predictive-state test. Genuinely new repository machinery is required to: (a) load and align the already-accepted per-family feature outputs across the 41 representatives, (b) freeze the composite model spec and split policy before any fit, and (c) run the walk-forward evaluation and BH-FDR multiplicity correction, producing an EPOCH34 structural result artifact.

decision.scope_rationale: Family is open, not in blocked_scope_set, and its natural role (state/predictive fusion) is the only legal home for a genuinely distinct multi-feature hypothesis; it does not reuse or rerun any previously opened identity or diagnostic outcome bytewise.

next_research_state.post_implementation_follow_up: Once EPOCH34_COMPOSITE_CAUSAL_ML_STRUCTURAL_RESULT_V1.json is produced, a fresh AI reasoning pass is required to interpret it before any economic promotion is considered; no ranking or economic panel selection is authorized by this proposal.

objective.goal: Design and implement a genuinely distinct, prospectively frozen non-economic structural screen that fuses the already-accepted univariate structural feature outputs (trend-continuation, mean-reversion, breakout, cross-sectional rank, seasonality/session, relative-value alignment, and both regime-conditioning waves) into a single composite predictive-state model under the CAUSAL_ML_PREDICTIVE_OR_STATE_MODEL family, evaluated on the 41 frozen structural representatives, to test whether joint conditioning surfaces structural edge that no single univariate family test could detect.
objective.information_gain_rationale: Every currently legal (non-blocked) mechanism family (TREND_MOMENTUM, MEAN_REVERSION, BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION, SEASONALITY_SESSION_TIME, RELATIVE_VALUE_COINTEGRATION, CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING, REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED x2, CAUSAL_ML_PREDICTIVE_OR_STATE_MODEL) has already completed one frozen univariate non-economic structural pass at the current 41-representative frontier (Epochs 24-33), and economic_outcomes_delta has remained 0 across all of them. Re-running any single family with retuned parameters on the same observed bytes is prohibited. The highest-information legal action outside the blocked scopes (CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE, CROSS_MARKET_LEAD_LAG) is therefore a genuinely new hypothesis class: a joint/composite conditioning of already-frozen, reusable non-economic structural features, which has never been tested and does not reuse any single family's diagnostic outcome to redesign that same family's test. This is a legitimate fresh prospective hypothesis under CAUSAL_ML_PREDICTIVE_OR_STATE_MODEL, not a reparameterization of any closed test.
